asChild.description:
Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

Use `render` when you need the part's state: `render={(props, state) => <MyButton {...props} />}`.

id.description: Overrides the generated id. Use when two error texts share the same `match`.

match.description:
Narrows when the error text shows:
- a `ValidityState` key shows it only for that native failure
- `true` forces it visible (e.g. driven by an external form library)
- omitted shows it whenever the field is invalid

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Pass an element to have the part's props merged into it, or a function to control the merge
yourself and read the part's state.

type.description:
The state the indicator reflects. Hidden (not unmounted) unless the state
matches, so CSS transitions survive:
- `required`: the field is required (e.g. an asterisk)
- `invalid`: committed validity is invalid
- `valid`: committed validity is valid — a pristine field shows neither
- `validating`: an async validation is in flight (e.g. a spinner)

dirty.description:
Whether the field's value has been changed from its initial value.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

disabled.description: Whether the field is disabled. Also inherited from a surrounding native `<fieldset disabled>`.

errors.description:
Errors from outside the field, such as a server response. They mark the field invalid
until the user changes the value, and show again when different errors are passed or the form is submitted.

ids.type: Partial<{ root: string; control: string; label: string; errorText: string; helperText: string }>
ids.description: The ids of the elements. Useful for composition.

invalid.description:
Whether the field is invalid, regardless of computed validity.
Use for app-level errors (e.g. server errors) the machine cannot compute itself.

onValidityChange.description: Called when the committed validity changes.

render.description:
Render the part as a custom element, combining their props and behavior.

Pass an element to have the part's props merged into it, or a function to control the merge
yourself and read the part's state.

target.description:
The item whose control the field tracks, for fields composed of multiple controls.
The tracked control id (and the root label's `htmlFor`) become `{id}:item:{target}`.
`ids.control` overrides this.

touched.description:
Whether the field has been touched.
Useful when the field state is controlled by an external library.

validate.description:
Custom validation, run against the value and the native validity snapshot.
May return a promise; a newer validation run supersedes an in-flight one.
